name: TooltipBody
description: The standard tooltip body: a heading (the x or category), then one row per series.
signature: ({ title, meta, rows, footer }: { title?: ReactNode; meta?: ReactNode; rows: readonly TooltipRow[]; footer?: ReactNode; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: footer
props.description: Content below the rows (a total, a hint); omitted when empty.

props.name: meta
props.description: Secondary text beside the title in the heading (a time range, a unit).

props.name: rows
props.description: One row per series: swatch, value, label and optional detail, in order.
